entries.title: Proverbs 19:2
segments:
CHAP. XIX. 
 
  V. 2. Hasteth-That rashly and headily rushes into actions.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:3
segments: V. 3. Perverteth-Blasts his designs and enterprises.  Fretteth-He ascribes his unhappiness not to his own sin, but to God and his providence.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:7
segments: V. 7. Brethren-His nearest relations.  Hate-Despise and shun him. Pursueth-Earnestly imploring their pity.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:10
segments: V. 10. Delight-To live in pleasure and outward glory, doth not become him, nor suit with him; because prosperity corrupts even wise men, and makes fools mad; and because it gives him more opportunity to discover his folly, and to do mischief both to himself and others.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:13
segments: V. 13. Dropping-Are like rain continually dropping upon an house.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:15
segments: V. 15. Casteth-Makes a man careless, and like one asleep in his business.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:16
segments: V. 16. His ways-The commands of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:18
segments: V. 18. While-Before custom in sin, and thy indulgence have made him incorrigible.  Let not-Forbear not to give him due and necessary correction.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:19
segments: V. 19. Great wrath-Of strong passions.  Deliver-If thou forbear to punish him.  Do it-Thou must deliver him again and again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:22
segments: V. 22. The desire-The hearty desire of being kind is accepted by God, and should be owned by men as a real kindness.  A poor man-Who is not able to give what he desires to do.  A liar-Than a rich man who feeds the poor with fair promises, but doth not perform what he pretends.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:23
segments: V. 23. Satisfied-Shall be fully contented with God's favour and blessing.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:24
segments: V. 24. Bring it-To feed himself; he expects that the meat should drop into his mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:25
segments: V. 25. Scorner-An obstinate and impudent transgressor.  Simple-Who sin thro' ignorance, being possibly drawn to it by the scorner's evil counsel or example.  Reprove-A verbal reproof will be more effectual for his reformation, than the severest punishments will be to a scorner.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:26
segments: V. 26. Wasteth-His father's estate.  Chaseth-Causes her to avoid his presence, and to go from the house where he is.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:28
segments: V. 28. Scorneth-Hath no reverence to the place of justice, nor to the presence of God there.  Devoureth-Utters it with greediness and delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:29
segments: V. 29. Prepared-Although they be deferred for a time, yet they are treasured up for them.
